purpose: Development test of Voice-Swap Handover against today's handover, student only, the calibrated SNR rule and a reversed control

algorithm.draft: S = eps + g(eps, 0), one student pass; eps independent of the teacher's noise (seed + 1009)
algorithm.swap: x = T - bandavg(T) + bandavg(S) on generated frames; bandavg is the per-band mean over generated frames; prompt frames unchanged
algorithm.handover: T is the guided teacher estimate at Step 4 on the released 16-interval sway grid; the released student loop at j = 1 then runs from x
algorithm.routing: SNR >= theta_hi: plain Step 4; theta_lo <= SNR < theta_hi: Voice-Swap at Step 4; SNR < theta_lo: reference Step 8

outputs.rswap_4: reversed control: x = S - bandavg(S) + bandavg(T)

reused: plain Steps 4 and 8 from EXP-018 steps1to8.csv and student only from EXP-017 grid32.csv; same seeds and T4 hardware

data.quality: first 60 development speakers by utterance ID x ['clean', 'noisy15', 'gauss18', 'gauss20', 'gauss22', 'gauss25']
data.diversity: first 20 development speakers, clean prompt, 20 seeds (input_seed + 1000 + m)

hardware: Colab Tesla T4 only, enforced by the runner: student noise depends on the GPU and the labels are T4 labels

failure_rule.description: Definition 3.1 Unacceptable Added Degradation Failure Thresholds

diversity_measure.name: CVf0 (DMOSpeech 2, Section 4.2)
diversity_measure.f0: librosa.pyin fmin 65.0 fmax 500.0 frame 1024 hop 256 at 24 kHz
diversity_measure.definition: per frame std/mean (ddof 1) of f0 across seeds, over frames voiced in at least 0.5 of the seeds; averaged over frames; then over pairs
diversity_measure.note: the paper gives no formula, seed handling or voicing rule; these are this study's choices

route3.theta_lo: from theta_hi down to 12 dB in 1 dB steps
route3.procedure: one fixed-sequence Learn-Then-Test chain per theta_hi, delta split equally across chains (Bonferroni); the cheapest certified pair is selected

criteria.C1_noisy_failures: noisy pooled, vswap_4 vs plain_4: failures at most 0.75 of plain_4, fewer, and exact McNemar p < 0.05
criteria.C2_clean_failures: clean, vswap_4 failures at most plain_4 failures + 1
criteria.C3_voice_is_the_cause: noisy pooled, speaker-bootstrap 95% CI of similarity(vswap_4) - similarity(rswap_4): lower bound > 0
criteria.C4_diversity: CVf0 95% CI, vswap_4 - student only lower bound > 0, and vswap_4 - plain_4 lower bound > -0.02
criteria.C5_beats_calibrated_snr: out-of-fold route3: lower mean passes than snr_theta with no more failures

decision_rule: Voice-Swap advances to a frozen test on fresh speakers only if C1 to C5 all pass; otherwise it is reported as a negative result, with no retuning on these data
evidence_status: development evidence; the speakers were inspected before this design; not the thesis's frozen held-out evaluation (EVAL-001/EVAL-002)
adoption: not adopted; replacing the thesis method needs a dated decision record and adviser review
